description: This file defines the KpiModel class within the OrangeHRM system, representing a KPI data structure for API serialization. It includes metadata annotations, uses traits for serialization and service interactions, and provides methods for initialization and converting the entity to an array including deletability status.

classes.name: KpiModel
classes.description: A model class for KPI data transfer in the API layer, wrapping the Kpi entity and providing serialization, filtering, attribute mapping, and deletion checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Kpi entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the KpiModel to an associative array, including a check if the KPI is deletable.
